displayName: GHADV-1284: DSpace has a possible Path Traversal Vulnerability in its Curation Task Reporter output path
description:
DSpace has a possible Path Traversal Vulnerability in its Curation Task Reporter output path

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: dspace has a possible path traversal vulnerability

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_path_traversal_ghadv_1284", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%dspace%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%possible%') AND "value" > 0
